answer: Operator Liability Pool. Each agent identity links to a real payout account; if any identity in a cluster gets flagged for coordinated fake activity, the pool charges the operator's payout account a fixed penalty per flagged identity and freezes the whole ripple of linked wallets. A fraud flag at one vertex propagates to every sibling identity. Cost: the operator loses a per-identity penalty plus the frozen garden of accounts, so running N fakes costs N times the penalty out of real funds.
